## Walkthrough

This PR updates the test infrastructure to support a new JAM conformance test vector version (0.7.2). It updates the test vectors reference commit hash in the load-test-ref.sh script, adds a new conformance-0.7.2 matrix entry to the GitHub Actions workflow, introduces a corresponding test runner script (jam-conformance-072.ts), and registers a new npm script for execution. All changes follow existing patterns established for other conformance test versions.
